newsitem.title: USA: SOCAL EDISON SETS RECORD POWER DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCAL EDISON SETS RECORD POWER DEMAND.

text.p: Southern California Edison Co (SoCal Edison), citing the current heatwave baking California, said energy demand on its system reached a record Wednesday, surpassing the previous high set Tuesday.
The new peak power was posted at 1500 PDT Wednesday at 19,084 megawatts (MW), up from 18,735 MW set Tuesday, SoCal Edison said in a statement.
The company, based in Rosemead, Calif., said it has sufficient energy available to meet the record load, but encouraged customers to use energy wisely.
The heat also is contributing to scattered power outages in southern California because the heat and increased electric load on the system is causing equipment problems, it noted.
SoCal Edison, a subsidiary of Edison International, serves about 11 million people in a 50,000-square-mile area within central, coastal and southern California.
